epic.title: Codex model-tier routing
epic.intent_and_why: Allow an external Codex crew caller to recover persisted optional model-tier metadata, including reasoning effort, without changing the Claude launch contract.

definition_of_done: Optional reasoning effort is threaded through parser, CrewSpec, registry creation, dispatch, relaunch, resume, and focused tests.
Legacy registry entries without reasoning effort remain readable through optional lookup.
Reasoning effort remains registry metadata and is never emitted in Claude argv.
Focused launcher tests and independent review pass without a blocking discrepancy.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Backward-compatible metadata-only threading with unchanged Claude argv and no external launcher behavior.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Focused launcher tests, the complete launcher test module, direct diff inspection, and independent reviewer approval.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded mechanical implementation and review wave.

hard_constraints: Do not add an external process launcher, migration, default change, or schema incompatibility.
Limit code and test changes to scripts/run_crew.py and tests/test_crew_launcher.py.
Do not mutate engine, hook, lifecycle, architecture, tracker, issue, or network state.
fixed_decisions: Reasoning effort is nullable registry metadata only.
Claude argv and defaults remain unchanged.
Legacy registry entries use optional lookup and remain readable.

current_wave.objective: Implement and independently verify the smallest backward-compatible reasoning-effort metadata path.
exit_criteria: Parser, CrewSpec, common registry creation, both dispatch backends, abandon/relaunch, and resume preserve the optional metadata contract.
Legacy entries without reasoning_effort resume without failure.
Claude argv excludes reasoning_effort and all focused launcher verification is green.
Independent review finds no blocking discrepancy.
